title: Set operations: bag `UNION ALL`; `INTERSECT`, `EXCEPT` with NULLs and NaNs equal; `ALL` keeps `min(m, n)` and `m − n`
description: `UNION ALL` keeps every row; `UNION`, `INTERSECT` and `EXCEPT` remove duplicates, with NULL equal to NULL and NaN equal to NaN of either sign. `INTERSECT ALL` keeps `min(m, n)` copies of a row (three 1s and two give two), `EXCEPT ALL` `max(m − n, 0)` (three and two give one; one NULL of two is left).
No set operation promises an order. The column types unify as in other expressions (`1 UNION 1.5` is `DECIMAL(11,1)`).
reference: `UNION ALL` is bag union and `UNION DISTINCT` its `distinct`; `INTERSECT` and `EXCEPT` are semi and anti joins with NULLs equal, then `DISTINCT`, and the `ALL` forms number equal rows, so `m` and `n` copies leave `min(m, n)` and `max(m − n, 0)` (#344). Grouping keys use `NAN_IS_NAN`.

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe observations (duckdb 2.0.0, Python, macOS arm64; session duckdb-characterization-gaps)
provenance.notes: `python -m sverify_dev.probe --observations` runs each query on a fresh connection under `TimeZone = 'UTC'` (or its own setup) and records the rows as they come; `tests/test_probe.py::test_observations_are_current` checks they are current.
